commits.message:
feat(console): report swallowed style errors through onStyleError (rich-diagnostics-un7.2) (#138)

* feat(console): report swallowed style errors through onStyleError (rich-diagnostics-un7.2)

A misspelled style name in a RichText renders unstyled with no trace, because
text.ts absorbs StyleSyntaxError so a bad style degrades instead of crashing.
That default stays. ConsoleOptions.onStyleError now hears about each absorbed
error, with the whole offending style string, carried to renderables on
RenderOptions beside the theme. A handler that throws makes rendering strict;
strict is a handler value, not a second flag.

* fix(console): state that onStyleError fires per resolution, not per string (rich-diagnostics-un7.2)

Review found a style can resolve twice in one print (a Strip joiner reads an
item's edge style), so "told about each style string" overpromised. Dedup
would need render-scoped state nothing owns; the doc now says what happens
and a test pins it. The new test block moves above the theme-resolution
header it had split from its describe.
